summary:
{
  "ledger": [
    "Large clear storage jar | Upright, open and empty on the wooden board, small side lug facing right | Upright and open on the same board, substantially filled with green and dark olives | Receives visible falling olives during the first pour at 00:00–00:03 and the second pour at 00:06–00:08; olives settle inside; no lid is applied.",
    "Small clear pouring vessel | Open and holding olives above the large jar, supported by the left hand with the right hand guiding its contents | Still held, tilted away from the large jar, with some green contents visible near its base | Manually tilted for the first pour, lowered to the metal bowl around 00:04, raised with another load around 00:05, then tilted for the second pour and lifted away around 00:09; fingers and the vessel base intermittently obscure remaining contents.",
    "Olives transferred into the large jar | Initially supported inside the small vessel; visible upper olives are green | Mixed green and dark whole olives supported by the large jar and one another | Fall through the mouth during visible pouring, bounce and settle; additional olives arrive during the second pour. Overlap prevents reliable identification or counting of every individual olive.",
    "Metal bowl | Upright on the counter behind and to the right of the large jar, containing olives | Remains upright in that area with fewer olives and exposed small brown pieces | Hands and the small vessel enter the bowl around 00:04–00:05; the vessel is subsequently raised containing olives.",
    "Metal-bowl contents | Green olives visible on top; lower contents obscured | A smaller assortment of green olives and brown pieces remains | Removal during the visible scooping/refilling action reduces the contents and exposes material underneath; no independently identifiable item can be shown to transform.",
    "Pale patterned bowl | Upright on the front-right counter, containing green olives | Still upright at the front right, partly cropped by the later framing | No visible handling or state change.",
    "Olives in the pale patterned bowl | Whole green olives supported by the bowl | Whole green olives remain in the bowl | No visible transfer or unexplained change; individual counts are limited by overlap and cropping.",
    "Small narrow clear bottle | First clearly exposed around 00:04 on the counter to the right of the metal bowl, upright with an open-looking neck | Remains upright on that counter until cropped from view | Earlier visibility is obstructed; no visible filling, pouring or movement after it is exposed.",
    "Wooden cutting board | Flat on the foreground counter, supporting the large jar | Flat on the counter, continuing to support the jar | No visible handling or physical-state change.",
    "Background stacked bowls | Nested on the rear counter to the right of the stove when visible | Remain nested on the rear counter until reframing crops them | No visible handling, separation or state change.",
    "Background white paper roll and amber bottle | Upright on the rear counter when exposed by the moving person and framing | Last visible upright in the same rear-counter area | No visible manipulation or state change."
  ],
  "findings": []
}
